title: Identification of distinct subgroups in Chinese patients with Behçet's syndrome via cluster analysis of immune cells and clinical features.
summary: Clustering of immune-cell and clinical features identified four patient subgroups in a prospective cohort of Chinese patients with Behçet's syndrome. This is a single-center stratification result, and the interpretation is limited to that design.
